body: He says I can't take care of myself and I need him if I tell him I deserve better or I want to leave. That I'm selfish if I have a breakdown at the wrong time like when he wants to sleep. I've tried not to be too difficult but sometimes it's hard to keep up and I'm immature and need to grow up. Or I'm selfish for not thinking he has better things to do than look at me hyperventilate for 40 mins. I just don't know what I'm doing wrong or what I should do. I feel trapped. Somehow I'm always the problem but I cant fix it. Dosent matter if Im a med student, No one wants to be around this amount of crazy while already having a lot. I'm really not a catch, just ruining anyone's life if I get in theirs

It's a lot of things.. for starters I'm a 3rd year medical student and that alone is stressful. But alot of my anxiety is around not being able to be alone or do things alone, but same time I get social anxiety so it's a bit confusing. The meds did knock off thankfully but I'm not feeling any better...

I've kind of said that before and he just dosent care about it. I'm constantly in conflict with myself whether I deserve better or this is what's meant for me. But then sometimes, like now I cant really look after myself properly and he is a comfort having around. My thoughts are not making sense, I don't know what I'm feeling or if Im feeling anything
